title: Dr. Solomon Olufunmilayo Olubunmi Badejo is a distinguished Executive Director of the Forestry Research Institute of Nigeria (FRIN) in Ibadan, Oyo State. Born on January 23, 1948, in Ogun State, Nigeria, he has had an impressive academic journey, starting from primary school to earning a Ph.D. in Forestry and Wood Technology. His career has seen him rise through various research and leadership positions within the institute, culminating in his appointment as Executive Director in 2007. Dr. Badejo has participated in numerous workshops and conferences both locally and internationally, and he has received multiple awards for his contributions to forestry and research. He is married and has children, reflecting a well-rounded personal life alongside his professional achievements.
